summary: Independently verified all four specified estimates after reading the complete main-paper and supplement markdown conversions, including all supplement sections. Extracted main PDF pp. 4-7 and supplement PDF pp. 10-12 with PyMuPDF, recovered Tables S5-S8 with find_tables(), and visually inspected in-memory renderings of the flagged main-text statistics and both regression tables. For s1_creativity_llm_vs_human_pooled, main PDF p. 5 confirms human M=2.311, SD=0.469; LLM M=2.45, SD=0.453; t(202)=-2.154, P=0.032, d=-0.301, and 95% CI (-0.266, -0.012). These are explicitly expert-rated objective creativity, despite appearing under the self-reported-creativity heading. The printed human-minus-LLM signs are preserved, and the unidentified CI estimand appropriately remains null. For s2_creativity_constrained_vs_batch_pooled, main PDF p. 6 confirms the response-type main effect F(1,200)=0.811, P=0.369, partial eta squared=0.004. No signed pooled total effect or pooled descriptives are supplied. Tables S5 and S6 confirm the pooled treatment/control counts of 104/100 for the respective experiments; main PDF Fig. 2 (p. 6) and Fig. 4 (p. 7) identify N=204 for the corresponding creativity outcome samples. For the two direct_adjusted records, supplement PDF p. 12, Tables S7 and S8, Model 4, confirms the assigned-condition coefficients and SEs of -0.186/0.230 and 0.029/0.146, respectively. These are creativity outcome equations adjusted for creative fixation and inspirational stimulation, with no task-complexity interaction in Model 4; they are separate from the original pooled total-effect analyses. The table note states bootstrapped SEs. Model-specific analyzed counts, coefficient tests, exact P values, intervals, and outcome standardization are not printed, so the relevant nulls are appropriate; the notes explain the schema limitation for bootstrap se_type. All requested codes, outcome identities, arm orientations, timing, and participant-level units and uncertainty bases agree with the methods. No preregistration is stated. The supplement_changes log contains only four additions of previously null pooled arm counts; every retained main-text statistic still matches the main PDF. All eight supplied mechanical flags are false positives: mathematical-font encoding and flattened subscripts explain the main-text mismatches, while the supplement quotes correctly select the row label and Model 4 cells as permitted by extraction-spec rule 2. No unresolved problems found.
